project_name: Osceola County Hyperscale Data Center Campus
status_detail: Low-confidence public tracker/social/news-derived record describes a proposed nine-building hyperscale campus totaling over 7 million sq ft on 434 acres near U.S. 441 north of Florida's Turnpike/SR 60 interchange; county/EDA searches surfaced NeoCity technology projects but no official county data center confirmation found during this pass.
notes: Include as weak lead because multiple public index/social snippets point to a large Osceola/Yeehaw Junction proposal, but official county pages reviewed did not validate the application; needs follow-up in county pre-application/rezoning records.

aliases: Central Park Commerce Center Data Center

developer: PBA Holdings, Inc.; WPB Logistics Owner, LLC
status_detail: Palm Beach County zoning page lists Project Tango applications for Central Park Commerce Center; revised plan included 1,032,000 sq ft of Data Information Processing use, but local reporting says commissioners voted 5-1 on July 15, 2026 to deny the Project Tango expansion while earlier entitlements for smaller data center/warehouse space remain.
notes: Official county record also says current approved site plan already showed two 100,000 sq ft Data Information Processing buildings; the larger Project Tango modification/expansion was rejected.

status_detail: Operator page markets a West Palm Beach colocation facility with cabinets/private suites, power/network redundancy, biometric access, and 24/7 facility access/support.

status_detail: No specific Pasco County data center project was confirmed in county/EDA/news searches; coverage found a one-year moratorium for large data centers in unincorporated Pasco County rather than a named application.
notes: WUSF/Fox13 report commissioners approved a 12-month pause on server/computer rooms over 2.5 MW; no named project surfaced.

project_name: American Tower Pinellas Park Edge Data Center
aliases: American Tower Tampa Bay Data Center
status_detail: American Tower filed a permit/proposal for a small-scale edge data center at 10700 76th Court North; local reporting says the facility would require conditional-use/public review and Pinellas Park advanced a one-year data center moratorium.
notes: City Legistar item is the moratorium ordinance; project specifics are from local/news/operator-industry coverage.

aliases: Bohler Places LLC Fort Meade data center
developer: Stonebridge / Fort Meade DC, LLC / Bohler Places LLC
status_detail: Fort Meade City Commission approved a development agreement in April 2026 for a massive hyperscale campus on about 1,300 acres; Polk County previously approved a 10-year Economic Development Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Fort Meade DC, LLC. Reports describe up to about 4.4 million sq ft, $2.6B investment, 50,000 gallons/day water request/reservation, and several permits still required.
notes: Official Fort Meade agenda PDF and local reporting confirm development-agreement path; capacity is reported from tracker/local opposition summaries as 1.2 GW and should be rechecked against application exhibits.

developer: Ryan Companies U.S. Inc.; Kimley-Horn listed as applicant/consultant in local coverage
status_detail: Proposed west Lakeland hyperscale data center near 923 Wilkinson Road/Old Tampa Highway; local reports describe 550,000-600,000 sq ft on roughly 60 acres, three data center buildings, mechanical yards, stormwater ponds and substation. Project remained under review/delayed after DRT meeting cancellation and zoning-code concerns.
notes: Capacity appears only in tracker (100 MW), while local news focuses on square footage and review status; treat MW as low confidence.

project_name: Cielo Digital Haines City Data Center
status_detail: Texas-based Cielo Digital Infrastructure made preliminary utility inquiry for a data center near Marion Road and State Road 544 East; local officials said the project is on hold/due diligence because Haines City lacks permitted water capacity, with no formal commission approval or formal application as of July 2026 local reporting.
notes: DCD and local news report about 74 acres and up to 150,000 gallons/day potable-water need; city officials told reporters no formal application had come before the commission.

status_detail: Data center directory record lists an Auburndale facility operated by Ntirety/DataCanopy; included as operational inventory lead but not verified against local permit records during this pass.
notes: Low-confidence operational colo/managed-services facility lead; needs operator/county record confirmation.

project_name: North Florida Data Center Site - East Palatka
aliases: 135 Gilbert Road East Palatka data center site
status_detail: CBRE listing markets a 1,317-acre East Palatka property at 135 Gilbert Road as a data center site, saying about 525 acres are usable, FPL confirmed at least 400 MW available, a third-party power-flow study found 1.4 GW of offtake capacity with minimal upgrades, and PUD rezoning is in process.
notes: This is a marketed site rather than a confirmed end-user project; Palatka Daily News/Facebook snippets say county officials stated no company inquiry had been confirmed, so treat status as early-stage site marketing.

status_detail: No named Santa Rosa County data center application confirmed. County official news page references a large-scale data center moratorium public hearing, and local reporting says officials debunked rumors and indicated no applications/pre-applications had been filed.
notes: Official source confirms moratorium activity; no project name/developer found in quick county/news search.

project_name: XF Group Cattlemen Road Data Center Inquiry
status_detail: Sarasota County commissioners voted to halt acceptance, review and approval of hyperscale data centers for at least one year; local coverage says the action followed an inquiry by XF Group to build a proposed data center along Cattlemen Road. Hyperscale threshold discussed was at least 50 MW.
notes: Only an inquiry, not a formal application, was found; status marked rejected because county moratorium blocks acceptance/review/approval through at least July 2027.
